notes.title: Update 3.1 - First Level Fix
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
A new update that fixes the record problem on the first level has been released.
This error appeared after updating to version 3.0 and it has been fixed. You'll now be able to register your record and obtain a clock as you would on previous versions of the game.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 3.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello there!

Mitch: Berry Challenge has been recently updated, improving the game in almost all their aspects.
Here's a list of the most important changes to the game
 [list]
    [*]Improved Particle Effects.
    [*]Improved Bloom Effect (The previous bloom had lower resolution and had some problems with certain screens, adding way too much bloom to the entire scene and almost not present on other screens).
    [*]Improved Camera Shake.
    [*]Minor fixes to most Levels and Game Bosses.
    [*]Minor fixes to some Multiplayer Levels.
    [*]Added support for newer and additional controllers.
    [*]Fixed a few minor bugs.
    [*]Fixed a major bug that made the UI confusing when pausing with different controllers on Multiplayer.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update!
Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Local Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/43df3b2034e50002e2b49c23d3bd6c59d349b3f2.gif[/img]

A new update has been released and it includes a completely new element for local multiplayer!

This shiny insect will occasionally appear while playing some local multiplayer matches. Hit the insect and it will drop some tasty berries!! But beware, hitting it might push you away a little so be sure to grab your berries before anyone else does!!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/9be779ca8efbc64d5d3b7b03b1447460e3ba2819.gif[/img]

Hope you enjoy the update!!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Movement Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/003988f1db408bdeee4b51c94a4e5c821437f1f1.gif[/img]

A new update, that modifies the character movement a bit, has been released.

In previous versions of the game, whenever you changed directions while running (from left to right and viceversa) your character would stop and then accelerate. Now that behaviour is faster, making you able to make longer jumps when switching directions. 

This will also have an effect on snow levels.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/4f2d6735e80afa3320d1787094d4b15928406ed3.gif[/img]


Hope you enjoy the update!
By the way, there are two more updates on the way, one of them is content and the other is a new item for multiplayer!! Stay tuned for more news.
In the meantime you can try out this code for multiplayer while on the Arena Selection Screen: ↑ ↑ X X ← → START (if you have a ps4 just switch X for Square or Attack Button if you have any other controller)

Thanks for playing!


Comparisons:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/6ac6bda7f178d23a99a41896795377585aa95c44.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/350488434729c497319d211b2dfddaab50fa4459.gif[/img]

You'll note that now when you jump while switching directions you'll form an arc, while in previous updates the jump would still take a bit to start moving on the desired direction forming more like half an arc, or a really stretched one.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/5df298e6418ca9fb5c2e79e5ed402e232a0e3aff.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/a574bc4796f324578826babbb912feeb61f1fedf.gif[/img]

notes.title: Local Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
A minor update has been published that makes the spike balls from the multiplayer emit a red aura when they are active.
This was due to the objects being too small on some screens making the spikes hard to be seen.

Hope you enjoy the update! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25519074/19d7fce4bb5ffb5f46d7e33a4e6431808b849388.gif[/img]
